test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

DEJECTED
solution:
The correct answer is **'depressed'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the given words and their meaning:
 
• **conceited**: excessively proud of oneself; vain
 
• **depressed**: a state of unhappiness or despondency
 
• **approved**: officially agreed or accepted as satisfactory
 
• **postponed**: cause or arrange for something to take place at a time later than it was scheduled.

Hence, the correct synonym for **dejected **is **depressed**.

 
• **Example**: *Georgina was **depressed **__after losing her first child.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** *

__
 
• The **synonyms **of dejected are: despondent, dispirited, disappointed, discouraged, disheartened, and depressed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• शब्दों का अर्थ
 
• conceited: अभिमानी
 
• depressed: अवसादग्रस्त
 
• approved: स्वीकृत
 
• postponed: स्थगित

इसलिए, सही पर्याय **अवसादग्रस्त **है।

 
• **Example**: *He was **depressed **__after losing the game.*
